audit.whatIsWrong: win[4] and phases[4] gave Level 6 to Graves while the why on the same row calls it 'even', and win[6]/phases[6] gave 2+ items to Illaoi while whys[6] says you reclaim tempo as the hyper-mobile carry. Packet chart is Graves, Skill, Illaoi, Illaoi, Skill, Illaoi, Graves.
audit.why: Two rows contradicted their own text and the packet.
audit.corrected: Level 6 set to Skill at 5/10 and 2+ items to Graves at 7/10, as one atomic group with both whys rewritten. Rows 0-3 and 5 already agreed and were left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was framed as your Collateral Damage spike. Leap of Faith is 120/95/70s and spawns a tentacle per champion hit; your answer is repositioning out of the ring with Quickdraw (16/15/14/13/12s, refunded by attacks), not out-damaging it.
audit.why: Her ult creates the field that beats you; your ult does not remove it.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why restated as the even exit window; phases[6].why now names the real 2+ item takeover — open-ground dash-and-burst away from the tentacles.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[10] claimed Smoke Screen 'blinds tower dives'. It applies no blind — reduced sight range, impact magic damage and a brief slow.
audit.why: Standing in the cloud does not stop tentacle slams or her autos; the value is that she loses sight of you and mis-aims Test of Spirit.
audit.corrected: report[10] restated. Note that the kit file's 'grounding' flag on Leap of Faith contradicts Riot's own text (which describes damage plus tentacle spawns only) — nothing on this page asserts that her R grounds Quickdraw, and nothing should.
sources: enemyKit R text vs derived flag

audit.whatIsWrong: packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. Every commit line said 'on Test of Spirit's cooldown' without ever giving the number.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s — that is a long, readable window and the only one that matters here.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now states 16s at rank 1 and what to do inside it.

audit.whatIsWrong: early, mid and late are written in FIRST person — 'Level 1 is mine', 'I can E in and shred her', 'my first item flips the lane back to me'. Every other field on the site is second person.
audit.why: A coach page that narrates itself in first person reads as someone else's diary, not instruction to the player.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten in the second-person voice at the same length, keeping every mechanical claim.

audit.why: packet flagged 'Land Test of Spirit' in wants.foe[1] — false positive; Test of Spirit is Illaoi's real E.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds an execute and a disengage knockback in one — hold it for either, never for chip.
edits.after: Leap of Faith rings you with tentacles, but Quickdraw exits the field while she is committed — even.

edits.before: You out-skirmish but the crit scalers pass you — convert to picks with smoke-screen blinds and R snipes.
edits.after: Two items: dash-and-burst on open ground away from her tentacles reclaims the duel and the tempo.

edits.before: Dodging the spirit pull is the entire matchup. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1 — dodge the pull, then take your trade while it is down.

edits.before: Your W smoke blinds tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.
edits.after: Smoke Screen cuts sight and slows on impact — no blind. Drop it as the gank arrives and fight them blind-sided in the fog.

edits.before: Level 1 is mine — my 4-shell point-blank spread out-bursts her single Q tentacle slam before any field exists, so if she walks up to last-hit I can E in and shred her. The moment she's level 3 with two or three tentacles down everything flips: her Test of Spirit (E) rips my spirit and I have to sprint from my own copy while the whole field beats on me. Don't greed last-hits next to her placed tentacles — take the CS with Q from range and only commit when I'm standing on clean ground.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours — the 4-shell point-blank spread out-bursts her single Tentacle Smash before any field exists, so if she walks up to last-hit, step in and shred her. The moment she is level 3 with two or three tentacles down everything flips: Test of Spirit (16s at rank 1) rips your spirit out and you sprint from your own copy while the whole field beats on you. Don't greed last-hits beside her placed tentacles — take the CS with Q from range and commit only on clean ground.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are her best window — True Grit stacking armor doesn't save me when she's landing tentacle slams and Test of Spirit on me at once, so I do NOT sit in her nest and "out-trade." At 6 it evens out: when she ults Leap of Faith and spawns a ring of tentacles, I Quickdraw or fire Collateral Damage straight out of the field and let her flail in an empty zone. Drop Smoke Screen on her to cut her vision and slow her so she whiffs E, then dash the instant she does commit — never trade standing still inside her forest.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are her best window — True Grit armor doesn't save you when tentacle slams and Test of Spirit land at once, so do NOT sit in her nest and "out-trade". At 6 it evens out: when she ults Leap of Faith and spawns a ring of tentacles, Quickdraw straight out of the field and leave her flailing in an empty zone. Drop Smoke Screen on her to cut her sight and slow her so the E goes wide, then dash the instant she commits — never trade standing still inside her forest.

edits.before: My first item flips the lane back to me — Eclipse/Youmuu's gives me the burst and the dash tempo to pick fights on open ground where her tentacles aren't, and I out-skirmish her all over the map. The trap is teamfights: if I let her Leap of Faith into a clumped group her tentacle field is monstrous, so I splitpush and force her to answer me 1v1 where my mobility wins. Decide the game in the mid-game skirmish phase before her sustain and a single big R can turn a fight.
edits.after: Items flip the lane back to you — Eclipse or Youmuu's gives you the burst and the dash tempo to pick fights on open ground where her tentacles aren't, and you out-skirmish her all over the map. The trap is teamfights: let her Leap of Faith into a clumped group and the tentacle field is monstrous, so splitpush and force her to answer you 1v1 where your mobility wins. Decide it in the skirmish phase, before her sustain and one big R turn a fight.
